candidate.definition_en: To go down on your knees.
candidate.explanation_ar: أن تنزل على ركبتيك (تركع أو تجثو).

senses.definition_en: To go down or rest on one or both knees.
senses.explanation_ar: النزول على الركبتين أو الجثو عليهما.
examples: Kneel down on the cushion if the floor is too hard.
The protesters decided to kneel in silent demonstration.
You should kneel so the children can see your face clearly.
